purpose: At the exact accepted C2a origin, quantify the isolated real-SWAP participant response to smaller fixed infiltration rates at the rejected C2b duration and head. Separate a target-rate transaction failure from the coupling residual criterion without changing any numerical budget.

fixed_conditions.origin: After accepted C2a publication at t=0.001 day; committed revision and interface ledger count are one.
fixed_conditions.participants: All 50, individually and discarded; no MODFLOW/application-service publication is implied.

gates.fresh_process_replay: Two independent executions must produce byte-identical JSON.

interpretation_limit: An isolated participant response that completes at a lower rain rate does not establish 50-column service publication, a complete-domain mass balance at that rate, or that the 0.1 cm/day target is reachable through a stable forcing ramp.
